title: Spectral Barron spaces of periodic functions
summary: Spectral Barron spaces are Fourier-Lebesgue-type spaces that arise in the approximation of functions by neural networks. Conventional spectral Barron spaces are mostly considered on the whole space or on a bounded domain with certain smoothness assumptions on the boundary. In this work, we investigate spectral Barron spaces for periodic functions, thereby extending the study of spectral Barron spaces to high-dimensional tori and, more generally, to locally compact Abelian groups.
